lines: Wait, what is this? Yikes, the suckers are latched onto me!!
They're super sticky! Ew, ew. Gross, gross!
I can't take it anymore. Let me go already! We lost, we lost, I said we lost! The octopus tentacles are gross, let me go nooooow!!
No need to be so disgusted. Hebiko is a little shocked...
Yukikaze was tangled up in Hebiko's octopus tentacles and unable to move.
All of the Taimanin recruits were crouched down. They didn't seem to have the energy to fight anymore.
Enough of this. I'm not going to do anything else today. I'm done with getting dragged into dumb fights! I'm not going to do anything!!
And one more person, Shikanosuke, was howling while lying on his back, spread-eagle.
Of course, if we had fought her head-on, even Yukikaze alone would have been too much for us to handle.
So to prevent Yukikaze from being able to show her true potential, I had made her run around completely pointlessly.
In the meantime, we had taken out the Taimanin recruits one by one until only Yukikaze remained.
Then I had read Yukikaze's movements and instructed Hebiko to tie her up.
Hebiko, that's enough. Let Yukikaze go.
Hebiko released Yukikaze from her tentacles lickety-split.
There's no winning or losing in this fight, though.
Surprisingly, Yukikaze didn't look too frustrated.
Rather, she seemed to have lost her motivation from the point when all the girls had been defeated first.
Everyone, are you okay? Can you stand?
The girls finally stood up when Yukikaze called out to them.
So, how was it? Do you feel a little better?
Their voices were calmer than before.
It wasn't like they had come to look at me favorably, but at least I couldn't sense any bloodthirstiness anymore.
Fuma himself isn't a bad person, so go ahead and forgive him.
It's fine if you can't, but he seems to have something on his mind as the head of the clan, so can you wait for him a bit more?
As Yukikaze tried to smooth out the situation, one of the girls spoke up.
Fuma, the bitterness of having someone you love get killed never goes away.
But we will be watching what you do next. Don't forget that.
Yukikaze approached me with a grin.
They said they'll be watching you from now on, Fuma♪
She tapped me on the shoulder, speaking to me in a strangely overfamiliar way. As always, she was patronizing me.
Well, I defeated the Lightning Taimanin who's considered the ace of the next generation. I need people to expect a little bit of me.
When I got slightly carried away and made a joke, Yukikaze looked at me in bewilderment and suddenly started laughing.
Don't tell me you thought that was my full strength? Wrong. Totally wrong. I told you. I was gonna "kinda" get serious.
Oh, that's what you think? That's fine. I'll get a bit more serious for you.
Yukikaze was pouting in discontent and slowly pointed her guns at the sky.
There was a violent electrical discharge around her.
It was more intense than anything I had seen in all of the fighting today.
Countless thunderbolts appeared out of thin air and got sucked into Yukikaze's guns.
Even though I wasn't being directly hit, my body was tingling, my hair stood on end, and a thick chemical odor hit my nose.
Shikanosuke, who had still been lying on the ground, let out his loudest scream of the day and clutched his head.
F-Fuma-chan, doesn't this look a bit dangerous?
Not just a bit. It looked quite dangerous.
But this was not a woman who would wait. This was the Lightning Taimanin.
The lightning didn't fall from the sky but instead stabbed upwards at it.
A bolt of lightning stretched out into the sunset, illuminated the area in white, and finally faded away.
Yep. I guess that's enough. Still only about half my full power, though.
Yukikaze puffed out her chest proudly.
Both Hebiko and I were completely speechless.
ーーーーーーーーーー
Shikanosuke was stupefied, as if his circuit breaker had tripped.
Huh? Wait, Fuma, Hebiko-chan, are you that surprised? Shikanosuke... oh, he's out.
Ahaha, did I overdo it a bit?
You're the one who just shot that, aren't you! What the hell do you think you're doing in a place like that?!
Yukikaze ran away so fast it made a whoosh. She was already at full speed.
Was that Rinko-senpai... Akiyama Rinko-senpai... the voice just now?
And that was the Lightning Taimanin... Mizuki Yukikaze...
Still in shock, I finally muttered my reaction.
